summary: the ISA, enumerated: the Clifford opcode group IS Sp(4,3) = 51840 = |W(E6)|, plus one cubic magic op. The degree-2 (Clifford) layer is a concrete finite opcode group -- the symplectic group Sp(4,3) on the substrate's F_3^4 phase space (the W(3,3) points), built by closure from its symplectic transvections (one shear x -> x + a B(x,v) v per substrate point, 40 points, a in {1,2}); closure order EXACTLY 51840 = |W(E6)| = 3^4(3^2-1)(3^4-1). So the free part of the ISA is literally the Weyl group of E6. Per-qutrit Clifford (mod Paulis) = Sp(2,3) = SL(2,3), order 24 = f. On top: ONE non-Clifford macro-op, the degree-3 E6 cubic form det(X) on the 27 (the unique E6 cubic invariant). Gottesman-Knill: Clifford = classically simulable; Lloyd-Braunstein: + 1 cubic = UNIVERSAL. Total opcode set = 51840 Clifford + 1 magic over a 27 = 3^3 operand register (a tryte). HONEST: the group orders (|Sp(4,3)|=51840=|W(E6)|, |Sp(2,3)|=24) are exact and computed by closing the transvection group; the symplectic formula and Gottesman-Knill/Lloyd-Braunstein universality are standard; the substrate content is Clifford group = Sp(4,3) = W(E6) (free ISA = E6 Weyl symmetry), operand register = E6 27, magic op = E6 cubic form; gate realisations are an implementation question. A finite, enumerated, balanced-ternary universal ISA.
